meta.name: remotion-render
meta.description: Render videos from React/Remotion component code via inference.sh. Pass TSX code, get MP4. Supports all Remotion APIs: useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig, spring, interpolate, AbsoluteFill, Sequence. Configurable resolution, FPS, duration, codec. Use for: programmatic video generation, animated graphics, motion design, data-driven videos, React animations to video. Triggers: remotion, render video from code, tsx to video, react video, programmatic video, remotion render, code to video, animated video, motion graphics code, react animation video

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 React 组件代码渲染成 MP4 视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用代码批量生成视频或动画
copy.tagline_en: Render React components into MP4 videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate videos or animations programmatically

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以将你提供的 React/Remotion 组件代码（TSX）渲染成 MP4 视频。支持 useCurrentFrame、spring、Sequence 等 Remotion API，可设置分辨率、帧率、时长和编码格式。
howto.when: 当你要求生成视频、动画，或提到“remotion”、“tsx to video”、“code to video”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 用这段 TSX 代码生成一个 3 秒的淡入动画视频。
把这段 React 动画组件渲染成 1080p 视频。
say.note: Claude 会使用你提供的代码和默认参数生成视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can render your React/Remotion component code (TSX) into an MP4 video. It supports Remotion APIs like useCurrentFrame, spring, Sequence, and allows configuring resolution, FPS, duration, and codec.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate a video or animation, or mention keywords like "remotion", "tsx to video", "code to video", etc.

say_en.text: Render this TSX code into a 3-second fade-in animation video.
say_en.note: Claude will call remotion-render and return an MP4 link.

say_en.text: Render this React animation component into a 1080p video.
say_en.note: Claude will use your code and default parameters to generate the video.
